text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have yet to find... the answer to 
'cuteness'.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
During a break, Duramente called out to 
me. Apparently, she was still pondering 
over 'cute is invincible'.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her expression was so dead serious that 
people passing by actively gave her a wide 
berth due to the heavy atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...What must I learn, and how, in order to 
acquire 'cuteness'?

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Being stoic as usual, she projected an 
aura that kept everyone at arm's length. 
If she wanted to aim for cuteness—
choice_data_list:
How about projecting an aura that invites 
people closer?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: People... approach me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente looked around her surroundings. 
While curious remarks like "Look, that's 
the girl doing so well lately" could be 
heard—

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
they only watched from a distance, and 
nobody dared to approach and speak to her.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it seems many people naturally 
wish to draw close to cute creatures...

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Nearby, people were watching a dog being 
walked. Seeing its tail wagging happily, 
someone even asked the owner for 
permission to pet it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...In that case.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...If someone approaches and pets me... 
does that mean I am cute?

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You aren't a dog or a cat— I hastily 
interjected to course-correct a somewhat 
confused Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then, to be petted by someone I 
place my trust in... let us make that my 
initial target goal.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
After all, if even someone I trust keeps 
their distance... I could hardly be 
considered cute.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the matter, Dura?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No, well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
? I'm on a break right now, so there's no 
need to hesitate. If you have something to 
ask, I can spare some time.

Coming to someone she trusts was a good 
idea, but she seems at a loss for what to 
actually do.

As a test, I try picturing animals being 
petted. What comes to mind is—
choice_data_list: A dog gazing right into your eyes...
A cat nestling close to your body...

text_block_list.text:
Thinking of a dog gazing up with watery 
eyes as if begging for headpats, I murmur 
it aloud, causing Duramente to react to 
the words.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I shall try it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ! Dura... Are you feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Eh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes are completely watery. Hey, come 
closer. Let me check your temperature—

Touching her forehead, Air Groove checks 
Duramente's temperature.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, no fever.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, do not push yourself. Health 
comes first.

Though she didn't achieve her initial 
goal—Duramente somehow looked quite 
pleased.

Thinking of a cat rubbing up and nestling 
close to act spoiled, I murmur it aloud, 
causing Duramente to react to the words.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...A-Alright.

Duramente tries nestling close to Air 
Groove, but freezing up, not knowing what 
to do next.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Dura?

As she pulls away and puts some distance 
between them in resignation—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what a strange girl. ...Did 
you perhaps want to be pampered?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: N-No... it's not like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ...Because on my end, I find 
myself in the mood to dote on you.

Air Groove gently pats Duramente on the 
back. While she hadn't accomplished her 
goal—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't patted on the head, so I must 
try again.

Duramente wore an expression that 
suggested she had developed quite a taste 
for it.
